Vijay Singh And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 14
May, 2024
Author: Saurabh Srivastava

Bench: Saurabh Srivastava
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:86518
Court No. - 82
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 23536 of 2007
Applicant :- Vijay Singh And Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Brijesh Sahai,Rameshwari Prasad
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate,R.K. Srivastava,Satyendra Narayan Singh
Hon'ble Saurabh Srivastava,J.
1.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Sri Romeshwari Prasad, Advocate along with Sri Krishna, learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. On the basis of several notices issued, appearance of Sri S.N. Singh, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has been made, who preferred counter affidavit and the same has been replied by way of filing rejoinder affidavit on behalf of the applicants, but even in the revised call, none appeared on behalf of opposite party no.2.

3. Considering the pendency of the instant matter, which is pending for last near about 17 years,
there is no option left but to proceed for final adjudication only on the basis of arguments raised by learned counsel for the applicants and pleadings available in the records.

entities.text: Vijay Singh And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The instant application under section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed to quash the entire proceedings of Case No. 1427 of 2006 (Minakshi vs. Ajai Singh and Others), arising out of Case Crime No.19 of 2003, under Section 498A I.P.C. and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Kavi Nagar,
District- Ghaziabad, pending in the court of learned Special Judicial Magistrate (C.B.I.), Ghaziabad as well as to set-aside the summoning order dated 03.11.2006.
5.

entities.text: Case No. 1427 of 2006 (Minakshi vs. Ajai Singh and Others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text:
Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Kavi Nagar,
District- Ghaziabad
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicants sought the attention of Court over the first information report lodged on behalf of the opposite party no.2, wherein the main allegation has been put forward against the husband and mother-in-law of the opposite party no.2 and rest of the other six persons being the close relative of the husband of opposite party no.2 has been implicated without any specific role assigned against them.

6. Sri Krishna, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicants also submitted during pendency of the instant application divorce decree has been extended as ex-parte in favour of the opposite party no.2 and the same has never been put under challenge on behalf of the applicants, at present opposite party no.2 is residing as a married lady being the U.S. citizen and the applicants are residing in Fiji.

7. It is also submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that during pendency of the instant application, husband and mother-in-law of opposite party no.2 has already been expired and dates of their death have already been mentioned, which is available in the records.

8. By bare perusal of the record, it is apparent that final report has already been preferred by concerned Investigating Officer under section 173 Cr.P.C. and the summoning order has been issued over the protest petition, which has been treated as complaint case by learned concerned court.

9. After hearing arguments raised by learned counsel for the applicants and by bare perusal of the record, it is crystal clear that the main allegation has been put forward against the husband and mother-in-law of the opposite party no.2, who have already been expired during pendency of the instant application and opposite party no.2 has already been granted divorce by the concerned court and at present, opposite party no.2 is residing in United States of America being a married lady and as a citizen of U.S. and rest of the other accused-applicants are having no specific role in connection to the allegation whatsoever has been put forward through F.I.R./complaint on behalf of the opposite party no.2.
10.

In view of the aforementioned facts and circumstances, the entire proceedings initiated against the applicants in shape of Case No. 1427 of 2006 (Minakshi vs. Ajai Singh and Others), arising out of Case Crime No.19 of 2003, under Section 498A I.P.C. and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act,
P.S. Kavi Nagar, District- Ghaziabad, pending in the court of learned Special Judicial Magistrate (C.B.I.), Ghaziabad, is hereby quashed and summoning order dated 03.11.2006 is hereby set-aside.
